regions.breakdown: "Alte" is the feminine form of "alt" (old), agreeing with "Apotheke" (pharmacy), a feminine noun. The phrase means "Old Pharmacy".
A compound term: "Fingernagel" (fingernail) + "Make-up" (English loanword for cosmetics).
An English loanword meaning the act or practice of body piercing.

where_youd_see_it: On the facade and windows of a building housing a pharmacy and beauty services in a German town.
cultural_note: In Germany, pharmacies often use a prominent red 'A' (for Apotheke) as a symbol, frequently featuring a serpent and chalice, as seen above the entrance here. The combination of a traditional pharmacy with modern cosmetic and body modification services in the same building is not uncommon, indicating diverse offerings under one roof or separate businesses sharing the premises.
